title: Fix HashRouting in App.tsx using react-router-dom HashRouter so /#/wishes renders AdminWishes only

requirements.text: Replace the current TanStack Router setup in `frontend/src/App.tsx` with `react-router-dom` hash routing by explicitly importing `HashRouter`, `Routes`, and `Route` from `react-router-dom`, wrapping the app in `<HashRouter>`, and defining exactly these routes: `<Route path="/" element={<Home />} />` and `<Route path="/wishes" element={<AdminWishes />} />`.

quotes:
Please fix App.tsx to handle HashRouting correctly:

Explicitly Import: HashRouter, Routes, and Route from react-router-dom.

Structure: Wrap the entire app in <HashRouter>.

Define Routes:

<Route path="/" element={<Home />} />

<Route path="/wishes" element={<AdminWishes />} />

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/App.tsx` uses `HashRouter`, `Routes`, and `Route` from `react-router-dom` (no TanStack Router usage remains in App.tsx).
Visiting `/#/` renders the `Home` page UI (hero, hearts rain, gift box, footer).
Visiting `/#/wishes` renders the `AdminWishes` page UI and does NOT render any `Home`-only content (including the GiftBox and any fireworks triggered from it).

requirements.text: Verify and fix routing behavior so that navigating directly to `https://cutiepie-uhp.caffeine.xyz/#/wishes` (or locally `/#/wishes`) does not show the homepage content as a fallback, and the admin wishes page is the only rendered page content for that route.

quotes: Verification: Ensure that when I am at /wishes, the Home component (GiftBox) is NOT rendered.

acceptanceCriteria: On a hard refresh while the browser URL hash is `#/wishes`, the first rendered page is `AdminWishes` (no flash of `Home` content that remains on screen).
There is no route configuration that renders `Home` outside of the `path="/"` route.

constraints: Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI component sources must be composed, not edited).
Do not edit immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`).
Keep the `/wishes` admin page hidden (no new navigation link/menu added on the home page).
nonGoals: No changes to the visual design/theme of the Home or AdminWishes pages beyond what is necessary to fix routing.
No additional routes or authentication/authorization for the admin page.
